antiFarmPolicy: FormLists must be small curated whitelists, not broad vanilla category lists.
Quest-stage sources must be terminal, one-shot, or source-marked; do not use whole questlines where every stage would score.
Harvest, weather, spell, and book sources must be whitelisted by exact form and then proven against generic loops.

PDV_PlayerEvents enforces source-level repeat gates before routing: book, spell, and quest-stage sources are one-shot per source/form/family; weather and harvest sources are once per in-game day per source/form/family.
Receivers remain silent when properties are empty, missing, or mismatched.
assetRequirement: No new mesh required; all six-race receiver sources are non-visible gameplay context, PO3 events, or exact vanilla records.
remainingBoundary: Curate and approve exact source records, fill the FormLists through the source-fill tool, register any terminal quest-stage sources, then prove accepted trigger, wrong-origin rejection, generic-hook rejection, repeat/anti-farm behavior, Survey/status clarity, stack snapshot, and manual feel evidence in game.
